surfaces.header: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-b border-black/5 (CRITICAL: Never use fully transparent headers)

visual_enhancers.borders: sharp or very subtle rounded-sm (max 4px radius)
visual_enhancers.texture: Use a subtle grain overlay in dark sections for editorial depth.

hero.instructions: Full viewport height (`min-h-screen`). Use Framer Motion for a line-by-line masked text reveal of the main headline. Image should have a subtle parallax effect on scroll. Overlay `bg-black/20` strictly to ensure text readability if placed over the image.

marquee.instructions: Slow, smooth drift. Background: `#f4f4f5`. Text: `#0a0a0a`. Large gaps (`gap-32`), uppercase serif font.

product_cards.instructions: Large high-quality imagery. On hover, image scales up slightly (`scale-105`) while the container maintains `overflow-hidden`. Text left-aligned below the image. Include a quick 'Add to Cart' or 'Buy via WhatsApp' micro-interaction.

manifesto.instructions: Numbered chapters (e.g., '01', '02') using large, light serif numerals. Staggered text blocks using Framer Motion scroll-triggers. Lots of negative space (`py-32`).

cart.instructions: Slide-out drawer (Shadcn Sheet/Drawer) with solid white background. Clean item list, bold total, stark black checkout button.

layouts.grid_strategy: Bento 'Tetris' grid for Featured Categories. Avoid perfect symmetry. Use spans like `col-span-8` and `col-span-4`.
layouts.spacing: Generous. Use `py-24`, `px-8` to `px-12`. Elements should have breathing room.
layouts.alignment: Optical alignment over geometric. Left-align text blocks, center only key massive headings.

motion.scroll: Lenis smooth scrolling is MANDATORY for premium feel.

animations.reveal: Masked upward text reveal on load (`y: '100%'` to `0` with `overflow-hidden` wrapper).
animations.hover: Image zoom inside containers. Button background shifts. Text color shifts.
animations.page: Subtle fade-ins for sections using Framer Motion `whileInView`.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 ratio. Test text over images.
accessibility.focus: Use high contrast focus rings: `focus:ring-2 focus:ring-black focus:outline-none`.

hero_and_featured.description: Chic fashion portrait in white fur coat. Best for Main Hero.
Woman in black top. Great for featured collection.
Trendy female in black suit. Excellent for Lookbook / Categories.

textures_and_abstract.description: White fabric smooth folds. Use as background for Manifesto or About.
Black fabric texture. Use for dark section backgrounds.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Use specific transitions.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, avoid `.App { text-align: center; }`.
Always use modern button styles like sharp or pill-shaped, with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯) for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Main agent relies on provided image URLs. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
CRITICAL: Use .js files, NOT .tsx files for components.
CRITICAL: Do not use fully transparent header backgrounds.
